question: Can a Nursing Home resident be given a facility, is it shown on the resident card, and does Nursing Home search match it? Check the snf resident schema/validators (convex/schema.ts, convex/lib/validators.ts snfFields), snf:add (convex/snf.ts), the Add Resident form (src/routes/snf/AddResident.tsx or wherever it lives), SnfPatientCard, and matchesPatientSearch (convex/lib/patientList.ts).

rule.pass: a facility can be entered (record, add mutation, Add Resident form), the resident card shows it, and Nursing Home search matches it
rule.fail: any of the three is missing (no facility field in the record, the add mutation, the Add Resident form, the card or the search matcher)
basis: A resident can be given a facility, the card shows it, and Nursing Home search matches it
No facility field in the record, the add mutation, the Add Resident form, the card or the search matcher means a physician cannot enter, see or search by facility

answers.answer: No. At e02167f a Nursing Home resident has no facility field anywhere in the chain. The snf resident record (snfFields in convex/lib/validators.ts, which convex/schema.ts spreads into snfResidents) holds name, age, dob, sex, mrn, unit and so on, but no facility. snf:add takes exactly those fields as its args, so the mutation can't accept a facility either. The Add Resident form asks only for Full Name, Date of Birth, Unit / Room and MRN, plus Encounter Type. SnfPatientCard builds its identity line from unit, dob, age and mrn. matchesPatientSearch matches on name, room, unit, mrn and diagnosis. A case-insensitive search for 'facility' under apps/web finds only prompt text, billing labels and comments, never a data field. This is exactly the recorded gap known:no-facility. As the oracle says, U4's facility part and U6's facility field are a Fail on TFA-92581, not Blocked or not-built, and that holds whatever Q1 decides about where facility comes from. No open question is waiting on this, and the question's pass/fail rule agrees with the Then/Oracle.

At e02167f, Nursing Home residents have no facility field anywhere in the chain. The snfFields validator, which both the snfResidents schema and the snf:add args use, has name, age, dob, sex, mrn, unit, diagnosis and so on, but no facility. The Add Resident form has four fields: Full Name, Date of Birth, Unit / Room and MRN. Its add() call sends no facility. SnfPatientCard builds its identity line from unit, DOB, age and MRN only. matchesPatientSearch checks name, room, unit, MRN and diagnosis only. A case-insensitive grep for "facility" under apps/web found only comments, prompt text, E/M code labels and OCR boilerplate, never a data field. This is exactly the recorded gap known:no-facility. So U4's facility part and U6's facility field fail on TFA-92581, as the oracle says. The oracle states this holds whatever Q1 decides, so the verdict does not wait on Q1.
